events.note: Authored for credential-evidence epic #238 (Group E follow-up) from the contract claims and handoffs E1, E2 and E3 cited in the expectation, before any scanner was consulted; carrier existence is provider-documented, the context policy is project policy. Not an independent review.

Decided 2026-10-06 by the sole maintainer (Milo Kang, milocosmopolitan, repository owner) for credential-evidence epic #238 (Group E follow-up), on the owner's instruction of 2026-10-06 (complete redact-secret#1228, #1229 and #1230 before the next release; Cases and baselines authored maintainer-only, as in Batch 2). No dissent was raised by the maintainer; the strongest counter-argument is recorded in the dissent field. Question: An empty api_key parameter, a placeholder, a reference, a masked display or a prose mention is not a credential value? Options: flag any non-empty api_key value; or treat these non-values as not credentials and leave the rest to the positive case. Decision: do not flag an empty value, an angle placeholder, an environment reference, a masked display or a prose mention. Reason: None of them holds a recoverable value; the admission of these forms is project policy and Airtable documents none of them. Finalized by the sole maintainer alone under the solo-maintainer period (ADR 0020): not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). Recorded by an AI agent on the owner's instruction.
events.dissent: A placeholder-looking or masked text can be a real value chosen to look like one, so not flagging it can miss a leak.
events.reversingEvidence: An Airtable statement that such a form carries a real value, or a second maintainer's retro-review that disputes it.
